definitions.explanation: Cancer of the pancreas ({膵臓|すいぞう}). Known for being difficult to detect early and for having a poor prognosis. The second element is often written in kana as {膵臓|すいぞう}がん.

examples.japanese: {膵臓癌|すいぞうがん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{発見|はっけん}→発見：00085_hakken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: Pancreatic cancer is hard to detect.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{膵臓癌|すいぞうがん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{亡|な}くなった→亡くなる：02639_nakunaru⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather died of pancreatic cancer.

examples.japanese: {膵臓癌|すいぞうがん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{初期|しょき}→初期：11742_shoki⟧⟦{症状|しょうじょう}→症状：03234_shoujou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}なく→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧、⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧とき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{進行|しんこう}している→進行する：26794_shinkousuru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Pancreatic cancer has few early symptoms and is often already advanced by the time it is found.

notes:
Cancer of the pancreas, notorious for late detection and a difficult prognosis. The second element is frequently written in kana: ⟦{膵臓|すいぞう}→膵臓：05960_suizou⟧がん.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {膵臓癌|すいぞうがん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{患|わずら}う→患う：27883_wazurau⟧: to suffer from pancreatic cancer
- {膵臓癌|すいぞうがん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧: surgery for pancreatic cancer
- ⟦{早期発見|そうきはっけん}→早期発見：16127_soukihakken⟧: early detection
